name: Kisaragi Yuna
source:
A second-year student who just transferred to Hakusen Academy.

She loves jokes and is easy to get along with, but partly because she just moved here, she doesn't have any friends to hang out with. She lives alone in a magnificent apartment that is out of place for her age, spending her time freely doing whatever she pleases.

Her grandfather is the head of a school of ancient swordsmanship, and having spent all her time there since she was little, she is a skilled swordswoman serving as the acting instructor of the Kisaragi Style.

Meeting Theodore, who was collapsed on the road, and revealing the true reason she came to this city sets Yuna's <Possibilities> in motion.
